It is derived from the given physical quantities related to the Rayleigh-Bénard convection problem, which include height (h), thermal conductivity (lambda), temperature difference (delta_T), gravitational acceleration (g), thermal expansion coefficient (alpha), kinematic viscosity (nu), and thermal diffusivity (kappa). Each input quantity's physical dimension is identified based on standard SI units and physical definitions, enabling dimensional analysis to confirm Nu is dimensionless.
